campaign_spec.purpose: Stress-test the Relational Compass and Selection Operator at scale (1,000,000 triads) to verify orientation stability and residue-conditioned cost reduction in massive ensembles.

allowed_claims: selection operator noise rejection at scale
node asymmetry survival in 10^6 triad systems

campaign_spec.primary_question: Does the relational compass -(i_a) maintain coherent orientation and cost-reduction across 1,000,000 triads, and does this coherence depend strictly on node asymmetry?

core_hypothesis.statement: Large-scale orientation coherence emerges from asymmetric relational distinguishability and is sustained by residue-conditioned cost reduction; symmetrizing the distinguishability metric destroys the ordering field regardless of scale.

resource_strategy.note: Implementation must bypass full O(N^2) T-matrix for N=10^6. Use neighbor-indexed adjacency lists.

phase_1_selection_scaling.purpose: Verify Selection Operator noise rejection across 1M triads.

phase_2_orientation_coherence.purpose: Measure global orientation stability -(i_a) across the 1M triad ring.

phase_3_residue_acceleration.purpose: Test if residue cost reduction accelerates loop closure at scale.

falsification_attack.purpose: Attempt to reproduce coherence in a symmetric substrate of equal scale.

vectors.name: Global Symmetry Fracture
vectors.attack: Force D(S1|S2) = D(S2|S1) for all 1,000,000 triads.
vectors.failure_condition: Orientation coherence persists above noise floor.

vectors.name: Selection Floor Bypass
vectors.failure_condition: System maintains basin identity under ambient noise.

vectors.name: Residue Cost Flattening
vectors.attack: Zero the residue_affinity term in the cost function.
vectors.failure_condition: Stabilization speed is unaffected at 1M triad scale.

falsification_attack.rigor_requirement: Falsification runs must use identical seed, triad count, and topology as the primary phase.

maximum_supported_claim.statement: Within this model, the Relational Compass generates scale-invariant orientation coherence across 1,000,000 triads, which is strictly dependent on node asymmetry and selection filtering.
